description: Page-level AI visibility recommendations, for when the user asks how to improve a page. With a saved result (requestId, trackerRunId or evidence) it reports on one measured prompt, charged only when the report includes page-comparison advice backed by quotes from inspected pages. Without one: url alone runs a free technical check of the page (robots.txt crawler access, indexing, rendering) and returns suggested buyer questions; url with query first runs a citations check, priced like cite42_citations, then the report. Prices are in cite42_pricing. Fetches the page, its robots.txt and up to two pages the AI surfaces cited, as returned HTML without JavaScript. No site-wide crawl, keyword advice or tracker activation. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

models.description: AI surfaces for the citations check that runs without a saved result. Ignored with a saved result.

query.description: A buyer question. With a saved result it picks one measured prompt; without one it is the question measured.

requestId.description: A requestId from your own successful Cite42 call within the last 30 days.

trackerRunId.description: A specific finished run of your own tracker within the last 30 days.

url.description: Your page that should answer the prompt. Without a saved result, url alone runs a free technical check; url with query runs a citations check first.

name: cite42_recommendations
